svg.title: Alizarin (Mordant Red 11)
svg.text: two C=O in the quinone ring
orange-red (with Al → red, Fe → violet-black, Cr → brown-claret)
madder root (Rubia tinctorum); synthetic from anthraquinone-2-sulphonate + NaOH fusion
Turkey red on cotton, wool; pigment lakes; Ca²⁺ test reagent (alizarin red S)
